name: Passport reissue for change of address
name_hi: पता परिवर्तन हेतु पासपोर्ट पुनः जारी करना
description: Apply for re-issue of passport to change personal particulars (address), submitting the old passport and proof of the present address.
description_hi: व्यक्तिगत विवरण (पता) बदलने के लिए पासपोर्ट पुनः जारी करने का आवेदन करें, जिसमें पुराना पासपोर्ट और वर्तमान पते का प्रमाण जमा करना होता है।
verification_notes: Based on the Passport Seva instruction booklet V3.0 hosted on passportindia.gov.in; the booklet's publication date isn't stated in the text. The Passport Seva web pages (psp) are rendered with JavaScript and could not be ingested. Category-specific additional documents (Annexures, Tatkaal, minors, government employees) are not modelled. The applicant may need to check the jurisdictional Passport Office for additional documents.

requirements.name: Old passport in original (with self-attested copies)
requirements.description: Original old passport with self-attested photocopy of its first two and last two pages.

requirements.name: Proof of present address (any one)
requirements.description: Needed because the address differs from the old passport.
requirements.notes: Proof of the present address only is needed, irrespective of how long you have lived there.

options.notes: Only public limited companies, on letterhead with seal.
Only if the applicant's present address matches the address in the spouse's passport.
Subject to successful validation with the Aadhaar database.
Photo passbook of a running account in a scheduled public/private sector Indian bank or RRB only (the official list does not mention bank statements).
